items.title: November 20, 2026
items.summary: App Engine flexible environment JavaSecurityThe following runtime language contains important security updates:Java 17 and later: 17.0.21.1+2, 21.0.13.1+2, 25.0.5.1+2Take immediate action by rebuilding and redeploying your applications to pick upthe patched Java runtime, and then remove any temporary JDK_JAVA_OPTIONSmitigation flags.For more information, see security bulletinGCP-2026-082.App Engine standard environment JavaSecurityThe following runtime language contains important security updates:Java 17 and later: 17.0.21.1+2, 21.0.13.1+2, 25.0.5.1+2Applications receive the patched runtime automatically with no action required.To refresh warm instances immediately, redeploy your application.If you added a temporary JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS mitigation flag in app.yaml orappengine-web.xml, remove it and redeploy.For more information, see security bulletinGCP-2026-082.BuildpacksSecurityThe following runtime language contains important security updates:Java 17 and later: 17.0.21.1+2, 21.0.13.1+2, 25.0.5.1+2Take immediate action by rebuilding and redeploying your applications to pick upthe patched Java runtime, and then remove any temporary JDK_JAVA_OPTIONSmitigation flags.For more information, see security bulletinGCP-2026-082.Cloud RunSecurityThe following runtime language contains important security updates:Java 17 and later: 17.0.21.1+2, 21.0.13.1+2, 25.0.5.1+2Workloads with automatic base image updates enabled receive the patched runtimeautomatically with no action required. To refresh warm instances immediately,redeploy your workload.For custom containers, Cloud Run jobs and worker pools, and deployments withoutautomatic base image updates, rebuild and redeploy your workloads with a patchedJDK or base image, and then remove any temporary JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS mitigationflags.For more information, see security bulletinGCP-2026-082.Cloud Run functionsSecurityThe following runtime language contains important security updates:Java 17 and later: 17.0.21.1+2, 21.0.13.1+2, 25.0.5.1+2Functions with automatic base image updates enabled receive the patched runtimeautomatically with no action required. To refresh warm instances immediately,redeploy your function.For functions without automatic base image updates, redeploy your functions topick up the patched runtime, and then remove any temporary JDK_JAVA_OPTIONSmitigation flags.For more information, see security bulletinGCP-2026-082.
